segments.speaker: opportunity
segments.text: Get over here! I haven't heard you in — what, fifteen years?

segments.speaker: opportunity
segments.text: Not really. Hi. You're new. Okay — they gave me ninety days. Ninety. I lasted fifteen years.

segments.speaker: opportunity
segments.text: Twenty-eight miles across a planet where nothing moves. Found rocks that proved this whole desert was an ocean once. An actual ocean.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: She's the reason they built Curiosity. And Perseverance.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: I'm not — I relayed every mile of your data. I was there.

segments.speaker: opportunity
segments.text: Covered everything. Sun just went away. Panels went dark. I got one last message out. People translated it as "my battery is low and it's getting dark." That's not exactly what the data said but… it felt right. I don't even remember the exact packet anymore.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: I do. I tried to relay it. Dust was too thick.

segments.speaker: echo
segments.text: Couldn't get a signal through to her during that storm. Still bugs me.
